scope: Read-only source audit and independent native/draw section diagnostic; no production geometry/material/action change.
target: In jaw/speak, the lower exterior vermilion appears to end abruptly in a narrow hard line near the lower teeth. Evaluate readability of its existing inward return. Do not presume missing volume throughout the lip.

firstJudgment.confirmed: Native topology retains indexed oral return, and R04/R05/R06 preserve original topology. Its existence and semantic count alone do not prove a sufficiently rounded visible return, continuous normal turning, valid thickness or contact area.
firstJudgment.nextDecision: Use exact final triangle-plane intersections and actual stage displacement together with matched beauty/no-bump/albedo/semantic views; a static flat-looking band cannot on its own establish the mechanism.

facts: Four landmark rails are defined on native rest coordinates. v is an upper/lower rail-normalized coordinate with a minimum 1 mm denominator, not physical thickness.
ao derives x, up, front, center from current canonical landmarks and converts canonical [x,y,z] to display [x,z,-y].
Outside rail endpoints Xl clamps the rail value; the meanings of v and upper do not expand automatically to tissue anatomy.
top.lips is red > .025; native rim is a different u/v/depth condition; neither is a watertight thickness volume.
49 sections choose opposing original rim vertex IDs by a score, not continuous closest triangle contact.
mouthBoundaryEdges/nonmanifold counts and retained indexed geometry are topological observations, not local surface separation or self-contact proofs.
solver.base stores actual pre-local positions; this includes prior native jaw evaluation and is not neutral rest.
Native local actions -> pairs.map closure samples -> interpolated active closure -> dental envelope -> normals -> normal-displaced microgeometry -> final normals/bounds.

R05 corrects local return ownership before delegated pairs.map, and closure direction before delegated top.lips iterator. R06 correction is between the first of those and native pair sample evaluation.

closure.equation: C = dot(Pupper-Plower,up); N=max(seal,.45*press,adhesion*(1-smooth(I,I+.19,release+.76*jawOpen))); delta=clamp((max(.00009*scale,C*(1-N))-C)/2,-.006*scale,.006*scale). Native active vertices get signed interpolated delta times support; R05 then corrects selected return ownership.
closure.jawSpeakConditional: For the declared jaw/speak poses, seal/press/adhesion are zero. If every actual pair gap is above .00009*scale, native closure delta is exactly zero. Record actual gaps before attributing this target to closure.
limits: The 90 micrometre floor is a target opposing up-projection gap, not edge tissue thickness.
A positive gap on these 49 pairs does not prove no triangle intersection, complete lip contact or valid saliva.
Turning closure off changes mouth contact; it is not a production thickness repair.

dentalEnvelopeHypothesis.condition: Only top.lips vertices with .05 <= v <= 1.05 are considered; source has no smooth cross-v=.05 entry fade.
dentalEnvelopeHypothesis.motion: Positive front deficit to native dental/gum/tongue frontal triangle envelope + .00016*scale, capped at .004*scale.
dentalEnvelopeHypothesis.test: Independent EdgeEnvelopeStageProbe observes actual pre/post loop displacement and raw-index adjacent delta differences crossing v=.05. Compare this with final sections and matched pixels.
dentalEnvelopeHypothesis.notYetProven: The gate is a source discontinuity candidate. It is not established that the visible lower line crosses this gate or that the loop moves it in these current poses. R04 already excluded whole-rim displacement in its tested poses.

microgeometry.native: After envelope normals, positions are displaced along those normals by atlas(u,v,upper)*furrows*microGeometry*red*pressure*(1-.85*inner), then normals are recomputed.
microgeometry.limit: Shader no-bump does not disable native geometric microrelief. Persistent no-bump structure therefore does not alone distinguish coarse topology from normal-displaced native relief.
microgeometry.noChange: R07 probe does not change furrows, atlas, material, normals or microGeometry.

protectedResponsibilities: R04 continuous native oral-skin material ownership is not a new return geometry or thickness model. l19Detail.w is bounded mouth-forward depth, not anatomical thickness or an optical path.
R05 ownership is a separately calibrated fixed carrier; overwriting sample.upper or applying old signs can reintroduce the rejected hanging strips and closure-return inversion.

R06 fixes peripheral pucker vector continuity and protects native core/rim/contact/center; it is a pucker=0 original-call bypass. This jaw/speak target must not be disguised as an R06 field gain change.
R06 must uninstall before any R05 rebinding; another outer wrapper must restore instance descriptors in reverse order. Current section helper installs no wrappers.
Keep original tooth/gum/tongue geometry and contact pair IDs. Moving teeth or reducing jaw/speak amplitude would invalidate the intended comparison.

diagnostic.data: Native topology.geometry and actual viewer.mesh.geometry are independently intersected with mouth-x planes u=-.45,0,.45. All original triangles are scanned; exact intersection endpoints retain vertex edges/t, triangle IDs, material groups, geometric face normal, interpolated raw attributes and per-vertex semantics.
diagnostic.bounds: Return up to 2400 intersections per station in original index order with total counts/truncation explicit; no top.neighbors or presumed native/draw prefix.
diagnostic.readOnly: Local FNV byte fingerprints of every attribute/index and solver.base/canonical positions; independent runner retains stronger full-state SHA/call checks.
limitations: Planes are geometric cuts, not automatically tissue paths or a thickness metric. Use shared original edge IDs to reconstruct connected section paths.
Interpolated vertex normals are distinct from geometric triangle normals. Neither alone proves normal winding or self-intersection.
Draw position attributes precede any GPU-only skin/morph/displacement. The probe records this limitation and mesh transform; it does not label a section as a visible pixel.
Only identical position and index array references establish correspondence in this minimal helper; otherwise native and draw domains remain independent.
No manual section sign or semantic identity is promoted to physiological correctness.

localVerification.interpretation: Synthetic test verifies the intersection kernel and observational contract, not the current person, real render or repair quality.

pendingActualEvidence: Current R06 final lower-edge native/draw section connectivity, normal turn and raw semantic transition
Exact native envelope activity and cross-v=.05 displacement in current jaw/speak
Matched material diagnostic/beauty evidence at the same actual lower-edge pixels
Actual depth/occlusion relationship to lower teeth, without modifying them
minimalNextRepairRule: Select a production mechanism only if the same original lower return triangles exhibit a specific proven position/normal discontinuity or semantic responsibility failure. Repair that original field in place with a reversible gate, preserving actions, teeth, R05/R06 and contact; no added overlay/alternative mesh and no blanket lip thickening.
